data.source: Mixed: synthetic pools (scripts/training_data/) + real-world data: SWMH (Ji et al., 2022; Reddit; CC-BY-NC), Dreaddit (Turcan & McKeown, 2019; Reddit; research use; official Columbia distribution)

sources: Dreaddit (Turcan & McKeown, 2019; Reddit; research use; official Columbia distribution)
attribution: Ji, S., Li, X., Huang, Z. & Cambria, E. (2022). Suicidal ideation and mental disorder detection with attentive relation networks. Neural Computing and Applications, 32.
Turcan, E. & McKeown, K. (2019). Dreaddit: A Reddit dataset for stress analysis in social media. Proc. 5th Workshop on Noisy User-generated Text (W-NUT), 97–107.
external.license_note: SWMH is CC-BY-NC and research-use only. Dreaddit is research-use. Neither is clinical ground truth and both are non-commercial; do NOT use the trained model commercially, and do NOT present metrics as clinical validation.
external.balancing: downsampled classes >6000 rows to 6000 (seed 314); duplicate weighting of the synthetic pool was attempted but was undone by the loader's de-duplication, so this model is effectively the balanced mixed corpus

evaluation.split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42); fold 0 held out as test. Groups = union-find clusters of rows with token Jaccard >= 0.6.
evaluation.cv_method: GridSearchCV with StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5) on the train split only; the test set is never used for CV or model selection.
caveats: 50175 external rows carry weak-supervision labels (subreddit-of-origin, not clinical assessment). Licenses/terms: SWMH is CC-BY-NC and research-use only. Dreaddit is research-use. Neither is clinical ground truth and both are non-commercial; do NOT use the trained model commercially, and do NOT present metrics as clinical validation.. Attribution: Ji, S., Li, X., Huang, Z. & Cambria, E. (2022). Suicidal ideation and mental disorder detection with attentive relation networks. Neural Computing and Applications, 32.; Turcan, E. & McKeown, K. (2019). Dreaddit: A Reddit dataset for stress analysis in social media. Proc. 5th Workshop on Noisy User-generated Text (W-NUT), 97–107..
Synthetic pool rows do not reflect real-world language; metrics are dominated by whichever source is larger.
The model is not clinically validated and must not be used for diagnosis.
Calibration inside CalibratedClassifierCV uses ungrouped 3-fold CV.

preprocessing: shared app.core.preprocessing (contractions + negation_scope + intensity + temporal + crisis)

onnx_v9.description: distilroberta-base fine-tuned at max_length=512 on the same group-aware fold-0 holdout (v9); INT8 ONNX. Recipe in docs/classifier_max_performance.ipynb.

evaluation.split: fold 0 of StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), identical to v7/v8

onnx_v9.calibration_note: softmax over logits, NOT calibrated like v7's sigmoid-calibrated LinearSVC — treat confidence_tier bands as directional.
onnx_v9.license_note: weights fine-tuned on CC-BY-NC / research-use corpora — non-commercial use only.
